info.name: sar-mot-kpis-v1
info.description:
Contract tests for GET /mot-kpis/business-domain/v1/kpis/{kpiCode} (api/sar-mot-kpis-oas.yaml).
Generated by tests/tools/build-collection.js - do not edit by hand. Error texts come from docs/ERROR-CATALOG.md.
Credentials are environment variables injected at run time (tests/run-newman.sh); none are stored here.
Folders (use with newman --folder): "Happy paths" [smoke, read-only], "Error rows" [errors],
"Fault injection (needs scratch config)" [fault-injection, catalog rows 6, 7, 13, 16; subfolders "FI-06 SpikeArrest 429",
"FI-07 Quota 429", "FI-13 Integration failure 500", "FI-16 Unmapped fault 500"; skipped unless --env-var faultScenario is set;
run only against a scratch deploy from scripts/fi-deploy.sh, see tests/fault-injection/README.md].
Waived catalog rows:
- Row 14 (502) WAIVED: Needs a scratch integration with malformed output (the DB constraints cannot produce it); logic covered by tests/unit/proxy-js-validate-integration-output.test.js and the RF-BadGateway checks in tests/unit/proxy-conditions.test.js (D44).
- Row 15 (504) WAIVED: Needs a scratch slow integration and the IntegrationEndpoint timeout; the 503/504 mapping is covered by the RF-GatewayTimeout and integration-fault checks in tests/unit/proxy-conditions.test.js (D44).

item.name: Fault injection (needs scratch config)
item.description: [fault-injection] Catalog rows 6, 7, 13, 16, one subfolder per scenario. Dev only, one subfolder at a time, after `bash scripts/fi-deploy.sh <scenario>`; restore with `bash scripts/fi-restore.sh`. Requests are skipped unless --env-var faultScenario=<scenario> is set. Procedure: tests/fault-injection/README.md.

item.name: FI-06 SpikeArrest 429
item.description: Catalog row 6 (SpikeArrestViolation -> 429). First deploy the scratch config: `bash scripts/fi-deploy.sh fi06` (spikeArrestRate=2pm, sliding window, UseEffectiveCount). Then: `bash tests/run-newman.sh dev --folder "FI-06 SpikeArrest 429" --env-var faultScenario=fi06`. Send nothing else with the test app in the minute before. Restore: `bash scripts/fi-restore.sh`. A must pass (window empty); B-D may still fit the 2-per-minute window (200) or be 429; E must be 429.

item.name: FI-07 Quota 429
item.description: Catalog row 7 (QuotaViolation -> 429). First deploy the scratch config: `bash scripts/fi-deploy.sh fi07` (quotaLimit=2 per 1 minute, distributed, synchronous). Then: `bash tests/run-newman.sh dev --folder "FI-07 Quota 429" --env-var faultScenario=fi07`. Request A waits for a calendar minute with at least 20 s left, so A, B and C share one quota window. Send nothing else with the test app in that minute. Restore: `bash scripts/fi-restore.sh`.

item.name: FI-13 Integration failure 500
item.description: Catalog row 13 (integration call fails -> 500 ERR-500-INTEGRATION). First deploy the scratch config: `bash scripts/fi-deploy.sh fi13` (triggerName=api_trigger/does-not-exist) and start a debug session (D39: record whether the IntegrationEndpoint raised a fault and its fault.name, V3/V9). Then: `bash tests/run-newman.sh dev --folder "FI-13 Integration failure 500" --env-var faultScenario=fi13`. The row 13 and row 16 messages are identical, so only the debug session shows which path ran. Restore: `bash scripts/fi-restore.sh`.

item.name: FI-16 Unmapped fault 500
item.description: Catalog row 16 (unmapped fault -> 500 ERR-SYS-500). First deploy the scratch config: `bash scripts/fi-deploy.sh fi16` (spikeArrestRate=abc; expected fault FailedToResolveSpikeArrestRate, which is not in the error KVM). If this returns 200 (the invalid rate fell back to 30pm), restore and use `fi16b` (quotaTimeUnit=fortnight) with `--env-var faultScenario=fi16b`. Then: `bash tests/run-newman.sh dev --folder "FI-16 Unmapped fault 500" --env-var faultScenario=fi16`. Restore: `bash scripts/fi-restore.sh`.
